# Support matrix

Synthetic-only prototype. Nothing here is a clinical-deployment, SMART-authorization, vendor-support or protocol-compatibility claim.

Revision `support-matrix/2`, policy revision `2026-10-19.1`, workflow `recent-labs-v1`, document support `metadata_only`.

The matrix classifies 25 of the 147 resource types in `hl7.fhir.r4.core@4.0.1` (source SHA-256 `b090bf929e1f665cf2c91583720849695bc38d2892a7c5037c56cb00817fb091`): 15 patient-linked types and 10 conditional shared types. Unclassified types are not readable. These are resource types, not clinical sections: M3b has 0 clinical sections.

A classified type is not permission by itself. Effective support is the intersection of this matrix, the source's advertised interactions and patient confinement; `fhir_capabilities` with `topic: "support"` reports it for the connected source.
